text:
mira: heads-up — mirror job for eu registry failed checksum on one layer, staging publish blocked by deploybot :warning:
deploybot: [publish-check] image: eu.gcr.io/redwood/service-graphql:staging-20260321 -> blocked
deploybot: reason=checksum-mismatch layer=sha256:8f4a3... details in /var/log/publish/1739513579.log
alex: ugh. any idea if it's a CI build problem or the mirror step? :thinking:
mira: CI artifact appears intact locally, digest matches source. failure happens during mirror->eu step (multipart upload retries).
sam: can you paste the deploybot log tail?
mira: ```
2026-03-21T01:12:03Z INFO mirror: start push
2026-03-21T01:12:12Z WARN upload chunk 7 retry=3
2026-03-21T01:12:30Z ERROR verify: checksum mismatch expected=sha256:8f4a3... actual=sha256:8f4a2...
```
jen: hmm looks like transient corruption during transfer. we've seen similar with eu edge earlier. network flakiness + chunked upload.
alex: options: retag+republish (fresh push), or pin current eu copy to previous known-good digest and unblock staging?
release-manager: risk-wise, prefer pin to last good digest for a patch window, republish in off-peak and then cut a hotfix if needed.
sam: agrees. pinning buys us time to validate release notes and smoke tests.
mira: I can pin the eu tag to previous digest (sha256:5b1c9...) and unblock deploybot now. then schedule a republish attempt at 02:00 UTC with extra checksum verification step.
jen: add an explicit post-publish verify: ``aws s3 cp`` style checksum compare or `gcloud artifacts docker images describe --format='value(image_summary.digest)'` after push.
alex: small nit — we must record the manual pin in changelog so audits know we temporarily pointed staging to an older digest.
release-manager: yes — include entry in release notes: "staging temporarily pinned service-graphql to sha256:5b1c9... due to mirror checksum failure; republish and re-verify scheduled 02:00 UTC."
mira: doing pin now. pinging deploybot for unblocking. :thumbsup:
deploybot: action=pin tag=eu.gcr.io/redwood/service-graphql:staging-20260321 -> pinned to sha256:5b1c9abcdef
deploybot: staging publish state=unblocked
alex: great. mira, after republish run a short smoke (10 req/s) and confirm KV cache warm before promoting.
mira: yep. I'll post results in this thread after the 02:00 run.
sam: thanks all. small follow-up: add a retry/backoff tweak for mirror agent to avoid silent corruption, file an infra ticket?
jen: I'll open INFRA-2489 for mirror agent retry policy and attach logs.
release-manager: sounds good. marking this resolved for now. say "resolved" when republish complete. :white_check_mark:
mira: resolved (republish succeeded at 02:07 UTC, post-verify matched, smoke passed). updated release notes and INFRA-2489 linked.
alex: nice. closing the loop. :tada:
